projects.name: TruMIS Enterprise Platform
projects.description: A modular platform for employees, projects, assets, vendors, learning and helpdesk workflows.
projects.problem: Enterprise workflows were spread across disconnected processes with inconsistent ownership and visibility.
projects.solution: Structured capabilities into modular services with clear API boundaries, secure access patterns and database-driven workflows.

projects.name: Interactive Service Request System
projects.description: Request and approval workflow designed for clear ownership, status tracking and faster resolution.
projects.problem: Teams needed a consistent way to submit, review and resolve requests without losing accountability.
projects.solution: Built a role-aware workflow with explicit state changes, REST APIs and a responsive interface for requesters and approvers.

projects.name: Employee & Workforce Management
projects.description: Workforce workflows spanning employee lifecycle, allocation, billability, projects and reporting.
projects.problem: Operational teams require data-rich tools that remain quick and reliable as records and reporting needs grow.
projects.solution: Designed searchable, pageable and cache-aware product flows to make complex business data easier to navigate.

projects.name: LetsDare
projects.description: Social Q&A game platform with real-time style interactions and a user-friendly responsive interface.
projects.problem: Friends need a lightweight way to play question-based games together, even when they are apart.
projects.solution: Built a responsive social game platform with Django-backed workflows and a PostgreSQL data layer.
